entities.summary: Myriam Marbé was a Romanian composer and pianist. She won a number of prizes, including the GEDOK at Mannheim in 1961, 1966 and 1970, six first prizes from the Composers' Union of Romania, the Bernier Prize and the Romanian Academy Prize.
